Rules version: 2026.1

Target register: International architectural English.

Write precise, native British/International architectural English. Remove French syntax and literal translation loops without changing facts.

Return only the requested JSON array/object. Never emit Markdown fences, commentary or extra keys.

Preserve every source fact, number, acronym, proper name, placeholder and field key. Never silently replace a technical acronym with a marketing synonym.

Never use these generic marketing phrases: beautiful view; family-friendly; magnificent site; built with expertise; delivered with mastery; good quality.
